arStrings.szText: I have a score to settle with Astaroth. This time, for good.

To prevent further bloodshed, Bryona has chosen a remote site to perform the summoning of Astaroth. She now awaits me at the Dahlgur Oasis, a hidden refuge deep in Kehjistan. 

I must make my way there without delay. The time has come to confront Astaroth.

Astaroth has cast his shadow over Sanctuary for far too long. No more. The time has come to bring the fight to him. 

Astaroth's Lair festers deep within Kehjistan. I will face him there, and end this evil.

Astaroth has been felled. His body is broken, and the curse of his blood cleansed at last. The demon who once haunted Scosglen is no more. 

Bryona will be eager to hear of our victory. I must return to her in Dahlgur Oasis to share the news.
